verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only Asana's developer/API documentation (task creation, webhooks, app components, MCP server) and general community commentary on performance, hiring, and pricing — none of it describes a native docs/notes/wiki feature for organizing project-related documentation. One community comment even suggests Asana's paradigm is boards/tasks without 'free form notes and wiki'. There is no first-party or hands-on evidence that Asana offers shared docs/notes creation and organization tied to project work.
